entries.text: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker’s\nSpeed stat.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_222
entries.text: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_223
entries.text: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_224
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat every time it\nknocks out a target.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_225
entries.text: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc\nit holds.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_226
entries.text: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon\nenters a battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_227
entries.text: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon\nenters a battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_228
entries.text: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon\nenters a battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_229
entries.text: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon\nenters a battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_230
entries.text: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from\nlowering the Pokémon’s stats.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_231
entries.text: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes\nwhile its HP is full.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_232
entries.text: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit\nthe Pokémon.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_233
entries.text: Powers up the Pokémon’s supereffective attacks even\nfurther.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_234
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the\nPokémon enters a battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_235
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the\nPokémon enters a battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_236
entries.text: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move\nit’s about to use. This works only once each time the\nPokémon enters battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_237
entries.text: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the\nPoké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_238
entries.text: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton\nfluff around and lowers the Speed stats of all Pokémon\nexcept itself.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_239
entries.text: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and\nmoves that draw in moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_240
entries.text: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the\nPokémon receives.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_241
entries.text: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back\nwith prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey\nto attack.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_242
entries.text: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and\nmoves that draw in moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_243
entries.text: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is\nhit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_244
entries.text: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon\nalso takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_245
entries.text: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by\nan attack.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_246
entries.text: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve\nthe damage taken from special moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_247
entries.text: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_248
entries.text: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as\na substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s\nappearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_249
entries.text: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_250
entries.text: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_251
entries.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of\nLight Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for\nboth opposing and ally Pokémon.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_252
entries.text: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon\nand its allies.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_253
entries.text: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the\nPokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns\nunless they switch out of battle.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_254
entries.text: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that\nhits it with a move that makes direct contact.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_255
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the\nuse of the first selected move.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_256
entries.text: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all\nother Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not\nbe triggered.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_257
entries.text: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being\npoisoned.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_258
entries.text: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between\nits Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of\nevery turn.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_259
entries.text: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_260
entries.text: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact,\nit can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_261
entries.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine\nfrom its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_262
entries.text: Powers up Electric-type moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_263
entries.text: Powers up Dragon-type moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_264
entries.text: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a\nchilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_265
entries.text: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a\nterrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_266
entries.text: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex’s\nUnnerve Ability and Glastrier’s Chilling Neigh Ability.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_267
entries.text: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex’s\nUnnerve Ability and Spectrier’s Grim Neigh Ability.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_268
entries.text: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s\nAbility to Lingering Aroma.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_269
entries.text: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon\nis hit by an attack.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_270
entries.text: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a\nFire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_271
entries.text: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the\nPokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def\nstats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_272
entries.text: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status\nconditions and halves the damage taken from\nGhost-type moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_273
entries.text: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type\nmoves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_274
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect\nor if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon\nalso takes no damage from wind moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_275
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated.\nMoves and items that would force the Pokémon\nto switch out also fail to work.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_276
entries.text: Powers up Rock-type moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_277
entries.text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind\nmove, boosting the power of the next Electric-type\nmove the Pokémon uses.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_278
entries.text: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it\nswitches out.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_279
entries.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the\nmouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.\nThe Pokémon then issues commands from there.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_280
entries.text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage,\nboosting the power of the next Electric-type move the\nPokémon uses.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_281
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh\nsunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_282
entries.text: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric\nTerrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_283
entries.text: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full\nimmunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_284
entries.text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the\nSp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_285
entries.text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the\nDefense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_286
entries.text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets\nlowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_287
entries.text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the\nSp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_288
entries.text: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a\nbattle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the\nPokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_289
entries.text: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon\nenters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon\nalso boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_290
entries.text: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the\nopportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_291
entries.text: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate\nthat Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one\nmore time.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_292
entries.text: Powers up slicing moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_293
entries.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and\nSp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies\nin its party that have already been defeated.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_294
entries.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s\nstat changes.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_295
entries.text: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team\nwhen the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_296
entries.text: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes\nopponents unable to use priority moves against the\nPokémon or its allies.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_297
entries.text: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP\nrestored instead of taking damage.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_298
entries.text: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using\nstatus moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by\nthe Ability of the target.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_299
entries.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally\nwith hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally’s HP.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_300
entries.text: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents’\nevasiveness, its accuracy can’t be lowered, and it can\nhit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_301
entries.text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nTeal Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Speed stat to\nbe boosted.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_302
entries.text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nHearthflame Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Attack\nstat to be boosted.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_303
entries.text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nWellspring Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Sp. Def\nstat to be boosted.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_304
entries.text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nCornerstone Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Defense\nstat to be boosted.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_305
entries.text: The power of the Pokémon’s toxic chain may badly\npoison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_306
entries.text: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the\nfirst time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering\nthe evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_308
entries.text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy\naround itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_309
entries.text: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type.\nAll damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its\nHP is full will not be very effective.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_310
entries.text: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses\nits hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and\nterrain, reducing them to zero.

entries.label: TOKUSEIINFO_311
entries.text: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt’s moves will also\nbecome confused.
